scripts.configure: cp packages/server/systemd/listr-sync.service ~/.config/systemd/user && systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user restart listr-sync
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && cp -r packages/client/dist/. ../listr-pages/ && cp README.md ../listr-pages/
scripts.deploy:pwa: pnpm --filter @listr/client build:deploy && cp -r packages/client/dist/. ../listr-pages/ && cp README.md ../listr-pages/
